rows.label: tlk46400071_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Fan-sama's funerary service
was so solemn and grand...

rows.label: tlk46400071_02_msg0002
rows.name:
I will never forget her beauty, nor
the sorrow of her passing.

rows.label: tlk46400071_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I wonder what will become of
Acedia without Fan-sama...

rows.label: tlk46400071_02_msg0004
rows.name:
I only hope we can continue living
in peace as we have until now...
